findings.title: Actual Machine context.get returns integrity-failed; selected legacy scope mismatch is statically visible
findings.description: The same-case retained raw receipt verifies worker9 method02 context.get returned domain integrity-failed at06:07:44.889395Z under exact API16 profile. Legacy MachineContextSessions.view_get calls machine_context_scope-v1.generate; generation.selected imports original custody_context_sessions and requires that exact MachineContextSessions type. The legacy type cannot satisfy this guard. This is a deterministic static mismatch on the selected call path, but earlier guard failure may intervene; the actual throwing boundary still requires a causal trace. Do not claim expiry or a proven dynamic root cause.

findings.title: Public Workflow transition currently supports only zero-output producer plans
findings.description: preflight explicitly requires allowed_output_carriers==[]. apply does perform an owned coordination transaction and exact replay; output_artifact_refs stays empty. Full workflow definitions declaring generated domain outputs cannot currently traverse this path.

findings.title: Native ontology append needs explicit process-interruption semantics
findings.description: persist_batch uses create_new sentinel .append.lock, synced temporary files and one hard_link per destination; rollback/removal happens only on returned errors. A process kill can leave lock/partial batch residue; reject_in_progress_append refuses lock presence. No observed failure is claimed, and local Store HEAD recovery must not be mistaken for this separate native protocol.

findings.title: Work and learning foundations are concrete controlled cases, not a generic completion proof
findings.description: C12 Work.perform audits exact13review members and explicitly excludes owner outcomes/Product benefit. Original Lesson application supports one inline-repair family and one controlled assessment; API successors generalize preparation/journal resolution but their public complete lifecycle remains unproved in the failed Source8 unit. Preserve real prior work evidence without treating a fixture PASS as broad human acceptance.

findings.title: Persistent custody cannot prove reconstructed or disposed live RAM after process loss
findings.description: ReadCustodian.inspect reports active metadata without a live consumer as indeterminate; close_consumer refuses to assert disposal for lost live resources. This is correct behavior to retain in API successors, archive and restart tests.

findings.title: Repeated fresh replay/guard boundaries can consume leases; safe optimization needs actual attribution
findings.description: Context.context revalidates generator, core replay and native replay. Machine.live checks schemas/resource/owner; LessonHost.guard additionally runs full host manifest, schemas/vault/resource and parent policy checks. Static repetition is visible, but total repeated guard counts/cost and a safe removal candidate need measurement. Existing sealed pure FactScope proves no effects and retains full entry/exit guards; no cross-call digest/permission caching is acceptable.

findings.title: Admission, source currentness and integrated qualification are separate
findings.description: Decision0075 admits v1 executable against D74. v2 D75 and integrated API16 are distinct candidates. Store.replay marks profile mismatch stale and require_current rejects writes; no task may mutate original source/profile bytes to renew permission or convert failed historical qualification into PASS.
